metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to find burned area data for the Alisal Fire during Oct 11-13, 2021. The best dataset would be MODIS Burned Area (MCD64A1) or VIIRS active fire data. I'll use MCD64A1 since it provides burned area directly. 2. Masking strategy: For burned area data, I don't need cloud masking since it's already processed. I just need to extract the burned pixels. 3. Logic: Calculate total burned area in acres and compare to 10,000 acres. Steps: - Define the fire location (Alisal Fire in Santa Barbara County, CA) - Use MCD64A1 collection for the date range - Calculate total burned area in square meters, convert to acres - Check if less than 10,000 acres Note: 1 acre = 4046.86 square meters ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Alisal Fire area in Santa Barbara County, CA (approximate location) const fireArea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-120.3, 34.6], [-120.1, 34.6], [-120.1, 34.7], [-120.3, 34.7], [-120.3, 34.6] ]]); const startDate = '2021-10-11'; const endDate = '2021-10-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area const burnedAreaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(fireArea); const colSize = burnedAreaCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Burned area images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No burned area data found for the specified dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get burned area mask (BurnDate band > 0 indicates burned) const burnedAreaImg = burnedAreaCol.first(); // Create burned area mask (pixels with BurnDate > 0) const burnedMask = burnedAreaImg.select('BurnDate').gt(0); // Calculate pixel count and area const pixelCount = burnedMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: fireArea, scale: 500, // MCD64A1 resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Burned pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No burned pixels detected in the area."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Convert to acres const pixelAreaSqM = 500 * 500; // 500m resolution const totalAreaSqM = pixelCount * pixelAreaSqM; const totalAreaAcres = totalAreaSqM / 4046.86; // Convert to acres console.log(`Total burned area: ${totalAreaAcres.toFixed(2)} acres`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalAreaAcres === null || isNaN(totalAreaAcres) || totalAreaAcres < 0) { console.log("Invalid area calculation."); console.log("C3"); } else if (totalAreaAcres < 10000) { console.log("Burned area is less than 10,000 acres."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Burned area is 10,000 acres or more."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
